intents.intent: Design each procedure from its nature, ontological object, boundary and human purpose rather than from pre-existing screens.
Continuously reduce cognitive load through object → why here → epistemic state → human decision → evidence → next action → handoff.
Every visible button, link and disclosure on selected procedure surfaces must have a journey anchor and evidence/authority semantics.
Use real screenshots as falsifiers for equal-weight process cards, excessive Scopo copy, visual overload and technical-detail competition.
AI may propose and compress; it may not silently decide, verify substantive truth or write another procedure decision.
Cross-procedure links and remediation handoffs preserve origin and create review work instead of silent target mutation.
Run 1,000,000 deterministic scenarios per selected process, including 100,000 nature falsification holdout states, and retain non-collapsed signatures.
Add compliance-onto-epistemic process-specific falsification beyond generic mutation families.
Monitor all and only binding EU law, binding Italian law, competent-authority decisions/measures and public jurisprudence/case information without personal data.
Human users can add links/files/text; AI suggests title, labels, summary, relevance, domain/application hypothesis and semantic concepts without becoming authority.
A dedicated scheduled AI contributor reuses the internal scheduler runtime and a bounded mining meta-prompt that asks for facts and sources.
Candidate source concepts are atomized into the epistemic lattice as proposed derived atoms, never silently promoted to decision.
Preserve the good EC model while reducing copy and exposing one next question/action; history, AI trace and provenance remain drilldown.
Rebuild AO as an auditor-readable governed register with unambiguous identity, source authority, owner, criticality/dependencies, attestation and lifecycle.
Every built-in law/standard/framework exposes minimal complete conceptual atoms instead of only acronyms or raw technical identifiers.
Fix transparent drilldown background and keep normative/conceptual detail readable.
Replace task-list UX with origin → adoption → execution → evidence → verification → closure, making why/owner/next decision legible.
Operational completion must remain distinct from verified closure and cancellation is a valid reasoned terminal outcome.
Do not functionally redesign RC-01 or AR-01 in this tranche; keep them under regression guard.
Materialize granular semantic commits and a GitHub PR; DoD closes only when model, browser, mutation, runtime, audit and exact-SHA CI are all green.
